risks.proof: A photo or short video of the monitor powered on showing a clear image

risks.proof: A photo showing the power brick and VGA/HDMI cable included
risks.if_unproven: priced as monitor only, no accessories

risks.proof: A close-up photo of the keyboard's full surface and connector end

risks.risk: Physical damage to monitor stand or casing not visible from this angle

Photo of monitor's rear port panel and any included cables
Photo of keyboard's connector (USB/PS2) and full key layout
